Before you come in

Good to know

01

Consultations are free

Bring the idea in and talk it through with an artist — consultations are free and do not require an appointment. Placement, size, how it ages: that conversation is the start of every good piece.

02

Walk-ins welcome

The shop works on both an appointment and walk-in basis. Walk-ins are always welcome if time allows.

03

Appointments, too

Planning a piece? The shop also books appointments — call the shop, stop by during business hours, or email your idea in.

04

Tattooing only

No body piercing. Tattoos are the whole craft here, and it shows in the book above.

The shop

Just outside historic downtown Lancaster

Skintonz Tattoo Studio sits at 1027 Dillerville Rd, just outside historic downtown Lancaster, PA. The artists are available to discuss any ideas you have — that’s the shop’s own standing invitation, and the consultation costs nothing.

The room works two ways: appointments for planned pieces, and walk-ins when the chairs are open. Either way, the work in the Flash Book above is the work that walks out of here.
